set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re
n='gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1'
def run(args):
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
  return p.returncode,(p.stdout+p.stderr)
 except Exception as e:return 99,type(e).__name__
_,info=run(['docker','inspect','--format','{{.State.Status}} {{.State.ExitCode}} {{.RestartCount}} {{.Image}}',n])
print('BOT_STATUS='+info.strip()[:250])
_,logs=run(['docker','logs','--tail','120',n])
lines=logs.splitlines()
selected=[]
for line in lines:
 if re.search(r'(Error|error|ERR_|MODULE_|Cannot|SyntaxError|TypeError|ReferenceError|Unhandled|CREATOR_|poll|FATAL|ENOENT|permission)',line,re.I):
  safe=re.sub(r'(?i)(token|password|secret|authorization)\S*','[REDACTED]',line)
  selected.append(safe[:180])
print('BOT_ERROR_LINES_BEGIN')
for line in selected[-24:]:print(line)
print('BOT_ERROR_LINES_END')
PY
